evidence.text: Nathalie

Nathalie, young and ambitious sorceress of the Kellem, is taken away to be executed. In her final hour, she looks terribly young. She tries to speak, but can only choke back a sob. When she faints, the guards carry her away and carry out the sentence with merciful speed.

You enter Nathalie's chambers, trying to find some sign of where she went. Surprisingly, she left no sign. No letter, no map. With a small amount of guilt, you search through her private papers for some clue. In her notes, you find one thing of interest:
Nathalie is moving slowly. Her wounded arm is bothering her. She keeps prodding at it with her finger and then wincing in pain.
Nathalie grins. _I have spent years rotting away in the Black Fortress, waiting to be called for the hunt. I would love another chance to show my skills._
_My fault,_ Nathalie mutters. _A spell went awry when I was fighting my way out. Was just a list of names and dates. Nothing important._
Nathalie is now loyal to you.
